question: How did the value per kg of Luxembourg's fuel imports (HS 27) evolve each year from 2015 to 2025?

limitations.message: Quantities are missing for part of the trade, so volumes and unit values cover only rows with a known quantity.

sql:
SELECT
  year AS period,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg,
  SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT qty_kg IS NULL) AS value_eur_with_qty
FROM v_lu_trade
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2015-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'import'
  AND hs2 IN ('27')
GROUP BY
  year,
  flow
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 10000
title: imports: +46.2 % (2015–2025)
insight: The value per kilogram of Luxembourg's fuel imports increased from 0.54 euros in 2015 to 0.79 euros in 2025.
Over this period, the imports' value per kilogram rose by 46.2 percent, with a median value of 0.59 euros per kilogram between 2015 and 2025.
The largest year-to-year increase occurred between 2021 and 2022, when the value jumped from 0.60 to 0.87 euros per kilogram.
The peak value was reached in 2023 at 0.93 euros per kilogram, before decreasing slightly in 2024 to 0.89 euros per kilogram.
The data only includes trade rows where quantities are known, so some volumes and unit values may be missing.

facts.text: imports: largest change between consecutive periods 2021–2022: 0.60 €/kg to 0.87 €/kg
